YES

The script verifies identical key sets across all three checkpoints, checks bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor in both fine-tunes before any merge, computes each task vector against the untouched base dict in float32, asserts exactly 48 merged and 114 output tensors, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`. One caveat that does not affect spec compliance as written: correctness of loading the sharded base depends on the unseen `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` helper, which is not shown in the artifact.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
